form.label: CEO — Enterprise Cyber Risk & Resilience
form.description: Board-level view linking cyber risk posture to enterprise strategy: material incidents, regulatory standing, customer trust, and financial exposure. Drill down: KPI -> Business Unit -> System -> Event.

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | dedup business_unit | table business_unit | sort business_unit

panel.title: Enterprise Cyber Risk Score (0-100, lower is better)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval sev_weight=case(severity="Critical",40, severity="High",15, severity="Medium",4, severity="Low",1) | stats sum(sev_weight) as raw_score count as incident_count | eval risk_score=round(min(100, raw_score/8), 1) | table risk_score
| inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND (severity="Critical" OR severity="High") | stats count as material_incidents
| inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(customers_affected) as customers_affected

panel.title: Total Financial Impact of Security Incidents

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(financial_impact_usd) as total_impact
| inputlookup compliance_findings.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND status="Overdue" | stats count as overdue_findings

panel.title: Risk Trend: Financial Impact & Material Incident Count by Month

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval month=strftime(strptime(date,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"%Y-%m") | stats sum(financial_impact_usd) as financial_impact count(eval(severity="Critical" OR severity="High")) as material_incidents by month | sort month
| inputlookup compliance_findings.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND status!="Remediated" | chart count by framework, severity

panel.title: Risk Heatmap by Business Unit (click a bar to drill into that business unit)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval sev_weight=case(severity="Critical",40, severity="High",15, severity="Medium",4, severity="Low",1) | stats sum(sev_weight) as risk_weight sum(financial_impact_usd) as financial_impact count as incidents by business_unit | sort -risk_weight
| inputlookup vendor_risk.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | sort -risk_score | table vendor_name, business_unit, criticality, risk_score, open_findings, incident_count | head 8

panel.title: Systems in "$sel_bu$" Ranked by Risk (click a bar to drill into that system)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" | eval sev_weight=case(severity="Critical",40, severity="High",15, severity="Medium",4, severity="Low",1) | stats sum(sev_weight) as risk_weight sum(financial_impact_usd) as financial_impact count as incidents by system | sort -risk_weight

panel.title: Underlying Security Events for "$sel_bu$" $sel_sys$ (deepest drill: raw incident record)

search.query: | inputlookup security_incidents.csv | where business_unit="$sel_bu$" AND (system="$sel_sys$" OR "$sel_sys$"="") | sort -date | table incident_id, date, severity, category, system, mitre_tactic, financial_impact_usd, records_exposed, regulatory_notification_required, status, root_cause

html.p: Drill-down path: Enterprise Risk Score / Material Incidents (Row 1) → Business Unit heatmap (Row 3, click a bar) → System within that unit (Row 4, click a bar) → individual incident record (Row 5) — the same identifiers (incident_id) trace directly to full SOC/vendor case detail in soc_alerts.csv and vendor_risk.csv via the CIO and COO dashboards.
